setup_steps:
cat > eval.py <<'PYEOF'
import torch
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
mid = 'JeremiahZ/bert-base-uncased-sst2'
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(mid)
model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(mid)
dev = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
model.eval().to(dev)
ds = load_dataset('nyu-mll/glue', 'sst2')['validation']
c = 0
for i in range(0, len(ds), 64):
    b = ds[i:i+64]
    enc = tok(b['sentence'], padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors='pt').to(dev)
    with torch.no_grad():
        pr = model(**enc).logits.argmax(-1).cpu().tolist()
    c += sum(int(p == l) for p, l in zip(pr, b['label']))
print(f"accuracy: {100*c/len(ds):.2f}")
PYEOF
